result.summary: The image depicts a residential street intersection with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like a stop sign and crosswalk markings are present, the markings are significantly faded and the pavement shows signs of wear and patching.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked near the intersection corners can obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Surface
hazards.description: The roadway surface within the intersection area is patched and uneven, potentially creating tripping hazards or affecting vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse lines with continental-style markings to significantly improve the visibility of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection corners to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and physically prevent parking too close to the crosswalk.

result.summary: This residential street intersection features sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The absence of crosswalks and curb ramps, combined with on-street parking that may limit visibility, creates an environment where pedestrians have no designated priority or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no visual cue to drivers or designated space for pedestrians to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of Kenmore Rd and Harlan St in the foreground.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street where silver and white cars are parked.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the intersection corners to provide accessible transitions from the sidewalk to the street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.
